claim: The phone's Today screen serves the house's money to owners and managers only (ADR 0253, Answered 2026-10-01 round 2, the founder: 'Close it to staff (Recommended)'). In both GET /mobile/feed and GET /mobile/today-pulse, money is exactly seesHouseMoney(req.user.role), which is roleSatisfies(role, 'manager') from procurement/order-approval-gate.ts, so null, an absent role, staff and any unknown string get the staff view; the controller hands req.user.role (the role in the token's house, re-read per request, ADR 0162) to both reads. For anyone else the feed builds no order-approval card, takes `amount` off every card and leaves counts.orderApprovals out; a card built from a notification gets the notification's message as its subtitle only for a type on MONEY_FREE_NOTIFICATION_TYPES (else the card's neutral line), and its meta cut to NON_MONEY_META_KEYS; the pulse makes no Toast sales read and leaves revenueToday, checksToday, revenueLastWeek and deltaPct out. Neither list names a type or key a writer census (2026-10-01) found carrying money. Owner and manager output is unchanged. Behaviour: mobile/mobile-feed-money-for-staff.spec.ts. This verify pins the shape, fails on origin/main 4bd11a00e and on 6a714f2a4, and kills 21 of 21 source mutations, including `const money = true` and `role !== "staff"` in either read.
